facts.fact: Maroc Telecom's 5,700 km transafrican terrestrial cable from Morocco to Niger via Mauritania, Mali and Burkina Faso is recorded as completed (2020-2022, about US$100 million), connecting the landlocked Moov Africa subsidiaries including Niger's to international bandwidth; the record gives 2022 and publication year 2022 stands as the date.
